courses.description: This course is an introduction to the design and implementation of programming languages. From the design point of view, we will study language features as tools for expressing algorithms. From an implementation point of view, we will study compilers, interpreters, and virtual machines as tools for mapping those features efficiently onto modern computer hardware. Rather than dwell on the features of any particular language, we will focus on fundamental concepts, the differences between languages, the reasons for those differences, and the implications they have for language implementation.
